source_text.body:
Schedule weekly internet research summaries
The poster is building a Cowork agent that collects research online and summarizes it, and is working out how to schedule it weekly.
·
Feb 16, 2026
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The poster was setting up a Cowork agent to search the web for research and summarize it, then wanted it to run every week without coding. In the thread, they say Claude kept claiming the create_scheduled_task tool was unavailable and suggested using a Shortcuts UI with a generated prompt file instead; a commenter said starting a new Cowork session and simply prompting “schedule task” plus the research instructions made Cowork add a scheduling skill and save the task in .claude/scheduled-tasks/.
How it went
The thread does not report research results or performance numbers; it is mainly troubleshooting how to make weekly scheduling work. The only concrete outcome shared is that one commenter got scheduling to work in a new session and later another commenter said the feature had arrived.
Worth knowing
Useful catch: the poster was a non-coder, and the main workaround shared was to start a fresh Cowork session and issue a very simple “schedule task” prompt.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Every [day] at [time], research the latest news and publications on [topic] from [preferred sources or websites], and write a one-page summary covering the [5] most important findings with links. Save it to [folder] as a dated file and include a short list of questions worth following up. Run it once now so I can check the format, and then set it up to repeat weekly. Don't email or share it with anyone without asking me.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1r69prm/scheduled_agent_task_in_cowork
